codeReview.summary: Clean, minimal fix that adds a MAX_LINE_LEN=256 constant and guards the line_buf.push(byte) call with a length check. The change is well-scoped — only the hw-test config receiver is affected, config parsing logic is unchanged beyond the push guard. Excess bytes are silently dropped, which is appropriate for per-byte handling to avoid serial output flooding.
